description: Registry of Open Data on AWS (infrastructure, transportation and energy datasets) is a registry of open datasets listed in Registry of Open Data on AWS, a registry of open datasets hosted on Amazon S3, published or maintained by Amazon Web Services Open Data Sponsorship Program. It is a searchable index of open datasets hosted on Amazon S3, with a description, licence, update frequency and access route for each; the datasets tagged infrastructure, transportation or energy cover power-system data, traffic and routing data, imagery and hydrological model output. Coverage: worldwide, dataset by dataset. The registry also lists many datasets outside these three tags; only the infrastructure, transportation and energy tags were taken. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset; the registry page of each dataset states the terms. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding cloud-hosted open data for infrastructure analysis. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-registry-of-open-data-on-aws.
